title: Identity Bindings
description: A reviewed snapshot of Identity Bindings: one Actor for a GitHub login, a Linear user id or a Buzz pubkey, each with the review's evidence link. Lookup is exact-match only, so an account with no binding is Unattributed. homer-catalog serves it and validates it fail-closed on every read.

updatedAt.description: When this snapshot was reviewed, UTC, ending in Z.

items.$comment: An agent names the human accountable for it; a human names nobody. One (source, sourceAccount) pair is bound once, the sourceAccount prefix equals source, and one actorId keeps one actorKind; those rules are in code.

sourceAccount.description: The raw source account, for example github:octocat. Its prefix must equal source.

accountableHumanId.description: Required for an agent, forbidden for a human, and it must name a human actor in this snapshot.

evidenceRef.description: The review's evidence: a decision, commit or pull request link. Never a secret, and never a 32-hex account id.
